scripts.title: buy and roll capsules instantly
scripts.script:
--CHIBI CROSSING CUMMER
-- Version: 3.2

-- Instances:

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
local BUY = Instance.new("TextButton")
local ROLL = Instance.new("TextButton")
local CHIBICROSSINGCUMMER = Instance.new("TextLabel")

--Properties:

ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui

Frame.Parent = ScreenGui
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(104, 85, 145)
Frame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 3
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.177033499, 0, 0.605026901, 0)
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 255, 0, 132)
Frame.Draggable = true
BUY.Name = "BUY"
BUY.Parent = Frame
BUY.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(156, 151, 226)
BUY.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(138, 49, 227)
BUY.Position = UDim2.new(0.0499283969, 0, 0.548684776, 0)
BUY.Size = UDim2.new(0, 73, 0, 31)
BUY.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
BUY.Text = "BUY"
BUY.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
BUY.TextSize = 14.000
BUY.MouseButton1Down:connect(function()
	local remotefunction= game.ReplicatedStorage.Aero.AeroRemoteServices.GachaService.PurchaseCapsule
	remotefunction:InvokeServer("WeebletCapsule") -- change capsule name of wich capsule you want to buy
end)
ROLL.Name = "ROLL"
ROLL.Parent = Frame
ROLL.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(156, 151, 226)
ROLL.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(138, 49, 227)
ROLL.Position = UDim2.new(0.625339568, 0, 0.548684776, 0)
ROLL.Size = UDim2.new(0, 73, 0, 31)
ROLL.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
ROLL.Text = "ROLL"
ROLL.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
ROLL.TextSize = 14.000
ROLL.MouseButton1Down:connect(function()
	local remotefunction= game.ReplicatedStorage.Aero.AeroRemoteServices.GachaService.Roll
	remotefunction:InvokeServer("WeebletCapsule") -- same as before change the name of the capsule you want to roll
end)
CHIBICROSSINGCUMMER.Name = "CHIBI CROSSING CUMMER"
CHIBICROSSINGCUMMER.Parent = Frame
CHIBICROSSINGCUMMER.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(156, 151, 226)
CHIBICROSSINGCUMMER.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(138, 49, 227)
CHIBICROSSINGCUMMER.Position = UDim2.new(0.152941182, 0, 0.0681818202, 0)
CHIBICROSSINGCUMMER.Size = UDim2.new(0, 176, 0, 35)
CHIBICROSSINGCUMMER.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
CHIBICROSSINGCUMMER.Text = "chibi crossing cummer"
CHIBICROSSINGCUMMER.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
CHIBICROSSINGCUMMER.TextSize = 14.000
